obs: - [benefit] The Add button offers Login, Card, Identity, Note, SSH key and Folder in one dropdown, so starting a CRM login or a server-access note took two clicks.
- [benefit] A login or secure note saves with only the Item name filled (username and password optional), so the CRM entry and the server-access note were each created in about three actions.
- [friction] The personal vault Add menu has no Collection option; sharing requires first creating an organization from a 'New organization' link tucked into the vault filter sidebar.
- [friction] Custom fields are not visible in the initial Add login dialog view; they sit further down the scrolled form, so I did not reach them in the time I had.

- [benefit] Creating a free organization took a name, a pre-filled billing email, the Free radio and Submit, and immediately produced a 'Default collection' plus a Members page with an Invite member button.
- [friction] The Free organization is limited to 2 users (including me) and 2 collections, so a 50-person team cannot be evaluated beyond a single teammate without moving to Teams.

- [friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed.
- [benefit] The vault and the org collections view both have a filter panel by type (Login, Card, Identity, Secure note, SSH key), plus Collections, Trash and a search box.
